capture_method: Native desktop browser screenshots of actual manual gameplay, captured by the coordinating operator; separate still images at selected scroll positions, not continuous recording.
screenshot_type: Actual game UI screenshots, not generated artwork or cover illustrations.

screenshots.title: Room 1 — read the letter
screenshots.caption: The return address shows its original letter text, with the read objective crossed out and 0/3 postcards. The player is facing north (0°).

screenshots.title: Wrong-angle capture is rejected
screenshots.caption: At 0% alignment and 0/3 postcards, the game explains that fragments are behind the player or hidden by a wall; no postcard is awarded.

screenshots.title: House captured — 1/3
screenshots.caption: The house fragments align at 100%, facing east (90°). The first postcard is marked collected, progress is 1/3, and the next room is open.

screenshots.title: Undo restores the uncaptured house — 0/3
screenshots.caption: After Undo, progress returns from 1/3 to 0/3. The aligned house remains visible at 100%, capture is available again, and the game says the previous step has been restored.

screenshots.title: Paper boat captured — 2/3
screenshots.caption: After recapturing the house and entering the second room, the paper boat is collected at 100% alignment, facing south (180°), with 2/3 postcards.

screenshots.title: Lantern captured — 3/3
screenshots.caption: The third room aligns a lantern at 100%, facing west (270°). All three postcard rows are marked collected and progress is 3/3.

screenshots.title: The ending is reached
screenshots.caption: The page is scrolled down to show the completed journey message and Start a new journey control, while the collection remains 3/3.

screenshots.title: Reload restores the completed journey
screenshots.caption: After reload, the game says the position and postcards have been restored. Progress remains 3/3, the ending remains visible and Undo is disabled; old undo history is not restored.

review.console_status: No console-error or console-clean claim is made by this record.
review.input_device_coverage: This records the observed desktop run, not a separate touch/mobile input evaluation.
